shared_elements: animal in profile with beaked/pointed head
band of repeated small units (rows of beads/zigzags)
justification: Both surfaces include beaked animal heads seen in profile, small discs, and bands of repeated small elements, but these are generic motifs that any tradition might produce independently. A is organised as stacked horizontal registers of separate creatures (quadrupeds, birds, a small squatting figure) rendered as sparse, rounded schematic silhouettes, whereas B is a single dense frontal costumed figure with headdress, ornaments and held objects, so the compositions and depictive conventions have essentially nothing specific in common.
